scope: Independent analytic and numerical audit; no firmware execution or formal proof

checks.name: Reference geometry quadrature
checks.detail: Path length converges within 10 µm between 10,000 and 20,000 intervals.

checks.name: Analytic derivatives through snap
checks.detail: Centered finite differences at 3,299 interior times; each derivative residual below 10⁻⁶ in its own SI units.

checks.name: Desired-frame orthonormality
checks.detail: Axes are unit length and mutually perpendicular throughout the trajectory.

checks.name: Quaternion integration and refinement
checks.detail: Midpoint body-rate exponential integration reproduces the analytic desired axes; halving the step reduces error by approximately four.

checks.name: Size and duration scaling
checks.detail: Doubling size doubles distance/speed/acceleration; doubling duration halves speed and quarters acceleration.
